root_motivation: Make the autobuilder corpus a queryable object: the 107 PRDs, 24 visions, 2 manifests, and REPOS.md describe a connected graph (vision→prd→repo) but the structure lives only in the reader's head. atlas-core builds the in-memory node set that /build, /dream, and jsy can query directly — turning an implicit mental model into a machine-readable, serde-serializable graph.
user_persona: jsy running atlas from ~/.local/bin/atlas on this laptop as part of the wintermute self-building system; also consumed by /build and /dream automation scripts that need machine-readable corpus state.

unfakeable_metric.name: acceptance_tests_passing_count
unfakeable_metric.harness_command: cargo test --workspace --no-fail-fast 2>&1 | grep -cE '^test acceptance_[a-z0-9_]+ \.\.\.  ok' || true

acceptance_criteria.description: cargo build --release produces target/release/atlas; cargo test green; cargo clippy -D warnings clean.
acceptance_criteria.test: tests/acceptance_ac1.rs: verify binary exists after build and cargo test exits 0

acceptance_criteria.description: atlas nodes --kind vision over the live corpus lists ≥24 vision slugs (excluding the _no_fleet_passes sentinel).
acceptance_criteria.test: tests/acceptance_ac2.rs: run atlas nodes --kind vision over fixture dir, assert ≥1 vision slug present and sentinel absent

acceptance_criteria.description: atlas nodes --kind prd over the live corpus lists ≥107 PRD nodes, each with derived status; no parser panic on any real PRD.
acceptance_criteria.test: tests/acceptance_ac3.rs: run atlas nodes --kind prd over fixture dir with ≥3 PRDs of varying frontmatter completeness; assert no panic, each has status field

acceptance_criteria.description: atlas show <vision-slug> lists PRDs for that vision with statuses; atlas show nonexistent exits 2 with stderr message.
acceptance_criteria.test: tests/acceptance_ac4.rs: fixture with a known vision slug shows ≥1 PRD; nonexistent slug exits with code 2

acceptance_criteria.description: A PRD whose build-manifest entry has a non-empty output_repo_path that exists on disk derives status shipped with repo_url; a PRD with no manifest entry derives drafted.
acceptance_criteria.test: tests/acceptance_ac5.rs: fixture with two PRDs (one with manifest entry+existing path, one without); assert correct status derivation

acceptance_criteria.description: --format json on nodes and show emits valid JSON that round-trips through python3 -m json.tool; text and json carry the same facts.
acceptance_criteria.test: tests/acceptance_ac6.rs: run atlas nodes --format json and atlas show <slug> --format json; pipe through python3 -m json.tool; assert exit 0

acceptance_criteria.description: Cold run of atlas nodes over the live fixture corpus completes in <200 ms (no-store budget).
acceptance_criteria.test: tests/acceptance_ac7.rs: measure wall time of atlas nodes over fixture; assert < 200ms

acceptance_criteria.description: All four source paths are env-overridable (ATLAS_AUTOBUILDER, ATLAS_BUILD_MANIFEST, ATLAS_DREAM_MANIFEST, ATLAS_REPOS); test suite uses fixture dirs, never live ~/.claude or ~/wintermute.
acceptance_criteria.test: tests/acceptance_ac8.rs: set all four env vars to fixture paths; assert atlas runs without touching live dirs

acceptance_criteria.description: README.md documents node model, source resolution, and the read-only invariant.
acceptance_criteria.test: tests/acceptance_ac9.rs: assert README.md contains 'node model', 'ATLAS_', and 'never writes'

scope: Parse PRD frontmatter from ~/wintermute/autobuilder/PRD-*.md (tolerant, line-scan, no dep)
Parse dream manifest JSON into vision nodes
Parse build manifest JSON into prd status (shipped/in-flight/drafted)
Parse REPOS.md markdown list into repo nodes
Provide in-memory graph of typed nodes: vision, prd, repo
Expose atlas nodes [--kind vision|prd|repo] [--format text|json] command
All source paths env-overridable for testing
non_goals: No persistent store — reads source files fresh on each invocation; never writes SQLite, JSON cache, or any file
No dependency edges between PRDs (atlas-edges is a follow-on PRD)
No graph rendering, DOT, or Mermaid output (atlas-render is follow-on)
No writes to PRDs, manifests, gossip, or REPOS.md — ever
No network access — all data is local files

additional.no_let_chains: MSRV 1.85 — do not use let-chains (stabilized in 1.88)
additional.deps_allowed: serde, serde_json, clap, anyhow; no SQLite, no fastembed, no tokio
additional.read_only_invariant: atlas NEVER writes any file in the corpus (PRDs, manifests, REPOS.md, gossip)

five_whys_trace.q: Why does jsy want a CLI that reads PRDs, visions, and manifests and shows a graph?
five_whys_trace.a: 107 PRDs, 24 visions, two manifests, and REPOS.md describe a connected structure (vision→prd→repo) but no tool joins them — the join lives only in the reader's head.

five_whys_trace.q: Why does the missing join matter now?
five_whys_trace.a: PRD status (drafted/in-flight/shipped) and repo URLs are spread across the build-manifest and file frontmatter; a human must mentally correlate them on every /build and /dream cycle, which is error-prone and slow.

five_whys_trace.q: Why can't /build and /dream just use the manifest directly?
five_whys_trace.a: The manifest knows build state but not vision ownership; vision files know which PRDs they own but not build state; REPOS.md knows shipped repos but not their originating PRD. The join requires reading all three sources and doing the cross-reference — that's a dedicated parser, not a jq one-liner.

five_whys_trace.q: Why build this as a standalone CLI rather than embedding it in /build or /dream as a script?
five_whys_trace.a: Root reached: the corpus is a durable artifact that will be queried by multiple consumers (/build, /dream, future tools, jsy manually); a standalone CLI with a stable --format json interface is the right primitive — it decouples consumers from parsing details and lets atlas evolve independently.

ambiguities_resolved.question: Does 'shipped' status require the repo to exist on disk, or just a non-null output_repo_path in the manifest?
ambiguities_resolved.resolution: AC5 in the PRD: output_repo_path must be non-empty AND exist on disk. A stale manifest entry pointing at a deleted path is not 'shipped'.

ambiguities_resolved.question: Should atlas nodes with no --kind flag list all node kinds mixed together or refuse?
ambiguities_resolved.resolution: PRD says 'list all nodes of a kind (default: all)' — so --kind omitted means emit all nodes of all kinds.

ambiguities_resolved.question: What is the unfakeable metric? The PRD names both a count gate (≥107 PRD nodes, ≥24 vision slugs) and a latency gate (<200ms). Which is primary?
ambiguities_resolved.resolution: acceptance_tests_passing_count is the primary scalar (the latency gate is one of 9 ACs, not the primary optimization target). The iterate-and-prove loop optimizes for all ACs green.
